name: pdk-dbt-twitter-organic-dbt
instr:
We turned on Fivetran history mode for the `tweet` and `organic_tweet_report` tables in our Twitter connection, and `twitter_organic__tweets` has been wrong since. Tweets show up more than once, edited tweets still show old text, deleted tweets are still there, metrics get counted several times, and some tweets show a name the account no longer has. A copy of the connection's four tables from this week is in /data/twitter_organic_2026-10-05/, in the same layout as the seeds in /app/integration_tests/seeds.

`twitter_organic__tweets` should have one row per tweet and day, with each tweet's current version and the account's current name. Tweets deleted on Twitter shouldn't appear. Metrics should count only the current version of each report row and leave out deleted report rows. A tweet with no report rows left still gets one row with an empty date_day and empty metrics, like today. date_day should be a date: the day the report covers in the account's time zone. For accounts that changed their time zone, that's the zone the account had for that report, and days reported before the change keep their day.

We also union an older connection without history mode, so tables without the history columns have to keep working the way they do now, with all their rows counted. `dbt seed` and `dbt build` in /app/integration_tests need to keep passing with the existing data tests. The change stays in SQL models, macros and YAML, with no Python models.

Could you find what's going wrong and
